what: MasTec builds infrastructure: power lines and substations, pipelines, mobile phone towers and fibre, and increasingly solar and battery projects. It supplies the crews and equipment rather than owning what it builds.
customers: Utilities, telecom operators, pipeline companies and renewable energy developers.
money: transmission lines, substations and grid work
solar farms, battery storage and civil works
moat: Crews with the licences, equipment and safety records to work on live electrical systems, which take years to build and which utilities will not hand to a newcomer.
risks: A 2.8% net margin, and a badly bid fixed-price job can wipe out a quarter
Revenue is concentrated in a few large customers
opportunities: Analysts see about 83% upside, the widest gap among large contractors
Revenue grew from $8.0B to $14.3B in four years
Data centre power demand has utilities spending heavily on transmission, its largest and best-margin segment
watch: Backlog by segment and the margin in Power Delivery.
